spelling_policy: Only explicit per-item forms are accepted. For W14 Q40, follow-up, followup and follow up are accepted spellings of the same noun; follow up uses two words. No general hyphen deletion, stemming or fuzzy synonym rule.
normalisation: Trim outer whitespace; collapse internal whitespace; Unicode casefold. No fuzzy spelling, automatic article deletion, plural stemming or unit deletion. Clock/numeric variants are explicit. Choice letters are case-insensitive. Two-choice items are unordered sets scored by distinct intersection.

questions.prompt: What distinguishes a causal explanation from a description?

options.A: It claims a particular change produced the observed difference
options.B: It merely repeats the recorded numbers
options.C: It requires no reasoning beyond a shorter wait

questions.explanation: A causal claim is stronger than a description, particularly when other conditions changed.

questions.prompt: Before comparing waiting times, participants should

options.A: assume matching column titles mean matching definitions
options.B: inspect the start and end definitions
options.C: calculate a precise difference before checking what was measured

questions.explanation: Equal labels or units do not resolve incompatible measurement boundaries.

questions.prompt: How should a missing wait be handled?

options.B: As the longest observed wait automatically
options.C: As missing, with any analytical treatment made explicit

questions.explanation: Silently replacing missing values invents information and may distort the comparison.

questions.prompt: What helps distinguish competing explanations?

options.A: Repeating the shorter-wait figure more confidently
options.B: Identifying observations that bear on each explanation
options.C: Assuming a group must agree immediately

questions.explanation: The next study should address a specific unresolved comparison rather than substitute confidence for evidence.

questions.prompt: What three things belong in the closing review?

options.A: A supported finding, an unresolved explanation and a next step
options.B: A claim that the planned comparison has already happened
options.C: A mechanism treated as proof of the outcome

questions.explanation: Findings, interpretations and proposed future work must remain distinct.
